queries.sql:
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    customer_id,
    product,
    origination_date,
    credit_band,
    dti_at_origination,
    credit_score_at_origination
FROM financial_services_banking.loans
WHERE product = 'personal'
  AND origination_date >= '2026-01-01'
  AND origination_date <= '2026-12-31'
ORDER BY origination_date;

SELECT 
    month_end,
    product,
    active_loans,
    loans_30plus,
    delinquency_rate_30plus,
    ROUND(delinquency_rate_30plus * 100, 2) AS delinquency_rate_pct
FROM financial_services_banking.credit_risk_report_delinquency
WHERE month_end = '2026-09-30'
ORDER BY product;

WITH sept_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        a.branch_id,
        mb.ending_balance
    FROM financial_services_banking.monthly_balances AS mb
    JOIN financial_services_banking.accounts AS a
        ON mb.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE mb.month_end = DATE '2026-09-30'
      AND a.account_type IN ('checking', 'savings')
)
SELECT 
    b.branch_id,
    b.branch_name,
    b.city,
    b.region,
    ROUND(SUM(sb.ending_balance), 2) AS total_deposits_usd
FROM sept_balances AS sb
JOIN financial_services_banking.branches AS b
    ON sb.branch_id = b.branch_id
GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.branch_name, b.city, b.region
ORDER BY total_deposits_usd DESC
LIMIT 5
